scope: Actual native UI and main IPC on disposable profiles; OS folder-picker result supplied; no model calls or Paper writes.
checks: Foreign profile backup refused before registration
Original revision content, pending proposal and stale receipt are readable
Unsupported data and inert external references preserved without execution/network
Read-only controls, narrow geometry and Escape verified
Registered source and exact original content survive restart
Other profile cannot read the same-slug original or reuse its source ID
Changed backup refuses and explicit refresh reads the restored original
Original documents, receipts and backup bytes unchanged
